LanguageData.DigitalStorage_StorageCore.label: Digital storage core
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_StorageCore.description: The core unit of the digital storage system. Items are held inside the core itself, taking up no map space and never aging or deteriorating.\n\nColonists anywhere can retrieve items from it, without walking to the core.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_WorkerCraftI.label: Crafting proxy I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_WorkerCraftI.description: Completes the recipes that workbenches within 13x13 can craft: orders are placed in the Craft automation panel and the workbenches do not need a bill. Ingredients are taken from a digital storage core and products are stored back into it. No colonist has to move. Stops when unpowered.

LanguageData.DigitalStorage_WorkerBuildI.label: Construction proxy I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_WorkerBuildI.description: Frames blueprints and finishes the construction on its own, taking materials straight from a digital storage core. If the core cannot supply everything, it hands the job back to your colonists. Stops when unpowered.

LanguageData.DigitalStorage_WorkerGrowI.description: Sows the right crop in growing zones and plant pots, harvests ripe crops, and cuts down trees the player has designated. Stops when unpowered.

LanguageData.DigitalStorage_WorkerTranscendent.label: Transcendent proxy
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_WorkerTranscendent.descri: The end of all four proxy chains. One building takes over mining, construction, cleaning and growing (including plant cutting) at the same time.\n\nSpeed 7.5x, skill level 20, up to 75 simultaneous jobs per work type (300 in total across all four), 6000W.
